correctness.rationale: The half-angle polynomial was independently checked against the source trigonometric product. For \(q>0\), the four roots have the asserted order except for the single positive-root crossover \(b_+(q)=3/q\), whose positive solution is \(\sqrt{3/5}\); the comparison \(a>e\) reduces to the positive square difference \(9(q^2+1)^2\). Polynomial sign alternation gives the two conditional intervals and hence the Cauchy probabilities. Irrational edge ratio supplies torus equidistribution. Independent high-precision quadrature reproduced \(0.639080422792129545195861596982\). Integration by parts transfers the same limiting fraction from momentum to energy weighting.
